notes.title: Grimdark Demo New Patch Release
notes.content:
Dear players!
We are pleased to present you an Demo update for our game! 
This update brings you the following improvements and innovations:
-New hero
-Rebalance enemy difficulty
-New enemy behavior
-New inventory and slot system
-New level up system
-New ability behavior
-Fixed errors and bugs that could affect the gameplay and stability of the game
-The game's performance has been optimized to make it run faster and more stable on different devices.

Don't forget to download the update to enjoy all these changes and innovations!

Best wishes,
Developler

More info in our Descord channel
https://discord.com/invite/C8qKSjTxj2

notes.title: Grimdark Demo 0.5 Release
notes.content:
After 2 months of hard Demo developing, Grimdark is now out in version 0.5!

Thank you everyone for playing the game and for your feedback!

I hope you all enjoy Grimdark in its complete (?) form!
